title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco Civic Center on 1987-01-28
lineage: MAC playback on Nakamichi DR-2 > Presonus Firebox/Neutrik Input > firewire > XP Pro PC/Wavelab 5 (recorded as 24bit/96 KHz WAV) > Waves L3, rendered to 16/44.1 using Waves IDR hi res CD dither settings > CDWAV 1.9 > FLAC (level 8 encoding)
source: Nakamichi 100s, taper's section > Sony D5 > Maxell MX90s

ai_review.summary: Good‑sounding 1987 show with a nostalgic 80’s vibe, highlighted by solid Eyes and a quirky Jack Straw despite a shaky Get Back.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate the concert highly, noting that even though it isn’t the band’s peak performance it captures the fun of the mid‑80s era. Highlights include Jerry’s lead on “Eyes” and a classic “Jack Straw”, while Brent’s keyboards keep the set listenable through a rough “Get Back”. The recording is considered listenable, though its exact source isn’t identified.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise the musical moments and find the audio listenable; minor criticisms keep the overall rating just above a solid four.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit source details are given, but reviewers describe it as listenable and appreciate its availability.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set has a relaxed, nostalgic flow typical of the mid‑80s Dead, with occasional slip‑ups that add charm rather than detract.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Positive mention of his playing on “Eyes”.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboards are credited with saving the show and keeping it listenable.
